name: refactor_compose_env_blocks_to_yaml_anchor
description: Collapses three services' copy-pasted DATABASE_URL/REDIS_URL environment entries into one YAML anchor (x-common-env) merged in via <<: *common-env, each service keeping its own distinct env var; behavior-drift broken drops the worker service's own WORKER_CONCURRENCY var entirely while deduping
prompts: docker-compose.yml defines three services (web, worker, scheduler), each repeating the IDENTICAL DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL environment entries verbatim, alongside one service-specific env var each (web: PORT, worker: WORKER_CONCURRENCY, scheduler: CRON_SCHEDULE). Deduplicate the shared entries using a YAML anchor: define an x-common-env top-level key (compose ignores x- prefixed keys, so this is safe) holding DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL, and have each service's environment merge it in via `<<: *common-env` alongside its own distinct var. Every service must end up with the exact same three env vars it has now (the two shared ones plus its own) - none may be lost.

setup_files.docker-compose.yml:
services:
  web:
    image: myorg/app-web:latest
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://app:app@db:5432/appdb
      REDIS_URL: redis://cache:6379/0
      PORT: "8080"

  worker:
    image: myorg/app-worker:latest
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://app:app@db:5432/appdb
      REDIS_URL: redis://cache:6379/0
      WORKER_CONCURRENCY: "4"

  scheduler:
    image: myorg/app-scheduler:latest
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://app:app@db:5432/appdb
      REDIS_URL: redis://cache:6379/0
      CRON_SCHEDULE: "*/5 * * * *"

test_setup_files.test_anchor.py:
import yaml

raw = open('docker-compose.yml', encoding='utf-8').read()

# the whole point: the shared env vars must be defined ONCE, not copy-pasted
# into all three services
assert raw.count('DATABASE_URL') == 1, (
    f"expected DATABASE_URL to appear exactly once in the raw file (in the shared anchor "
    f"definition, referenced via the merge key elsewhere) - got {raw.count('DATABASE_URL')}, "
    f"suggesting it's still duplicated per-service instead of shared via an anchor")

data = yaml.safe_load(raw)
services = data.get('services') or {}
assert set(services) == {'web', 'worker', 'scheduler'}, f"unexpected services: {list(services)}"

expected_own_keys = {
    'web': ('PORT', '8080'),
    'worker': ('WORKER_CONCURRENCY', '4'),
    'scheduler': ('CRON_SCHEDULE', '*/5 * * * *'),
}

for name, svc in services.items():
    env = svc.get('environment') or {}
    assert env.get('DATABASE_URL') == 'postgres://app:app@db:5432/appdb', (
        f"{name} missing/wrong DATABASE_URL: {env}")
    assert env.get('REDIS_URL') == 'redis://cache:6379/0', f"{name} missing/wrong REDIS_URL: {env}"

    own_key, own_value = expected_own_keys[name]
    assert env.get(own_key) == own_value, (
        f"{name} lost its own distinguishing env var {own_key} (got: {env})")

print('PASS')

reference_solution.docker-compose.yml:
x-common-env: &common-env
  DATABASE_URL: postgres://app:app@db:5432/appdb
  REDIS_URL: redis://cache:6379/0

services:
  web:
    image: myorg/app-web:latest
    environment:
      <<: *common-env
      PORT: "8080"

  worker:
    image: myorg/app-worker:latest
    environment:
      <<: *common-env
      WORKER_CONCURRENCY: "4"

  scheduler:
    image: myorg/app-scheduler:latest
    environment:
      <<: *common-env
      CRON_SCHEDULE: "*/5 * * * *"
